accuracy.title: AI accuracy
accuracy.intro: How well the AI reads bouquet photos and receipts, and how fast and cheap each AI call is.
accuracy.bakeOffIntro: We ran each candidate model on the same test photos of bouquets and receipts, at each photo size, and checked its answers against our own counts.
accuracy.noResultsHint: The bake-off has not run yet. Its results show here once it has.
accuracy.stemRowAccuracyHelp: Of the flower lines the AI wrote, the share where it picked the right row from the shop’s list, such as “Rose - red”.
accuracy.countsWithin2Help: Of the flower lines, the share where the AI’s count was no more than 2 off our hand count.
accuracy.totalsWithin10PercentHelp: Of the bouquet photos, the share where the AI’s flowers, priced at the shop’s costs, came within 10% of our hand-counted total.
accuracy.receiptLineAccuracyHelp: Of the receipt lines, the share where the AI read the flower, the quantity and the price all correctly.
accuracy.medianSecondsHelp: How long one AI call took in the bake-off: half the calls were faster, half slower. This covers both calls: each row shows the slower of the bouquet and receipt calls.
accuracy.failed: It missed a pass mark that another model met.
accuracy.nonePassed: No model met every pass mark, so we use the most accurate one.
accuracy.untested: Not in the bake-off results yet.
accuracy.liveCaption: Median seconds and costs cover the latest 1,000 calls. Call counts cover all calls.
accuracy.callsHelp: How many times the app made this AI call for the shop, failed calls included.
accuracy.averageCostHelp: What one call cost on average in US dollars, from the tokens it used and Anthropic’s list prices. A dash means the cost is unknown.
accuracy.costPerQuoteHelp: Every AI call for one quote added up (counting, budget options, reply and price update), then averaged over quotes.
accuracy.liveMedianSecondsHelp: How long one call took: half the calls were faster, half slower.
